notes: Developer AI editing preview: open a project, enter its editor and tap the sparkle button labelled AI edit. Pulse will create a separate AI cut and open it in Timeline view. Your original project stays unchanged.

Try a clear English talking-head recording around ten minutes long. The experiment selects original spoken passages to fit approximately 115 seconds; it keeps your original voice and the selected passages' order. Review the meaning and every join before sharing.

Before testing offline, download a speech model in On-device AI (Parakeet for English) and make sure Apple Intelligence is enabled and its model is ready. AI editing uses the on-device system model and never falls back to a cloud service.

After setup, try the same recording in airplane mode, with Wi-Fi off. Preview the new cuts, adjust them with the normal editor and export. Please compare essential points, sentence endings, repetition and the final MP4 duration.

Cancel or background Pulse while an AI edit runs, then try again. A canceled run should leave no partial AI-cut project. Use source-video speech with audio unmuted; separate voiceover takes are not supported yet. Unavailable models and unsupported devices show an explanation.

This is a developer-only experimental build. The AI edit button is hidden in ordinary release builds. This first implementation uses transcript selection with Apple Intelligence; OmniShotCut visual shot detection and newly written summaries are still follow-up work in issue 341.
